title: Anti-Pattern written: "do not use the command done"
shows: A cool task keeps being lost. The pool of never-won games for this kind has 3 games; code finds the invalid command `done` in 4 of 12 lost attempts and in none of the 6 won attempts of this kind, in 2 different tasks. The model only words it: "When cooling an object, do not use the command 'done'".
why_interesting: The Anti-Pattern pipeline: mined by code from pooled failures (never from one game), worded by the model, checked against wins. This one is legitimate (the agent really emits `done`) but low value.
